title: Project developer catalog messages through Anthropic
objective: Downgrade internal developer catalog messages to Anthropic-compatible user-role system reminders placed before the real user input.
context: Implement the accepted hybrid design: an initial developer-role catalog snapshot, append-only upsert/revoke deltas, on-demand SKILL.md bodies, and an authoritative execution registry.
The repository is a dirty shared worktree. Preserve unrelated changes and modify only owned_files.

source_evidence.note: Codex uses a bounded initial metadata catalog and loads full SKILL.md on demand.
Claude Code supports live skill discovery, visibility overrides, and on-demand skill bodies.
Append-only conversation messages preserve the previously cached prompt prefix.

include: Map RoleDeveloper catalog messages to system-reminder text blocks accepted by Anthropic Messages.
Keep stable system blocks and tool definitions unchanged.
exclude: Do not modify files owned by another task.
Do not add dependencies or perform unrelated refactors.

implementation_steps: Add request-capture tests for initial snapshot, delta, and ordinary messages.
Verify no provider-visible local metadata leaks.
acceptance_criteria: Anthropic receives catalog reminder before current user content.
Skill catalog changes do not mutate system or tool definitions.
risks: Anthropic has no native developer role, so ordering and safe wrapper semantics are contractual.
dispatch_prompt: Implement Anthropic projection for internal developer catalog messages with focused request-shape tests. Modify only the owned provider file and new test.
notes_for_assignee: Keep the diff narrow; if a dependency contract is insufficient, report the required change to the integrator instead of editing another task's files.
